title: Switching Macroeconomic Growth and Volatility: Evidence from a Mean-Variance Markov-Switching Dynamic Factor Model
title_zh: 宏观经济增速与波动的区制转换：基于均值-方差马尔可夫区制转换动态因子模型的证据
title_primary: 宏观经济增速与波动的区制转换：基于均值-方差马尔可夫区制转换动态因子模型的证据
title_secondary: Switching Macroeconomic Growth and Volatility: Evidence from a Mean-Variance Markov-Switching Dynamic Factor Model
authors: Catherine Doz, Laurent Ferrara, Pierre-Alain Pionnier
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: 官方在线 2026-09-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: As illustrated by the Great Recession, the COVID-19 pandemic and the global decline in GDP growth since the mid-2000s, economists need to account for sudden and deep recessions, shifts in macroeconomic volatility, and longer-term fluctuations in GDP growth. This paper puts forward a Mean-Variance Markov-Switching Dynamic Factor Model (MV-MS-DFM) that accounts for these stylised facts by allowing the mean and the volatility of macroeconomic variables to switch abruptly, and trend GDP growth to vary smoothly over time. We show that allowing for different volatility regimes improves the detection of turning points in the US business cycle, that the Great Recession and the COVID-19 pandemic only led to temporary increases in volatility, and that US trend GDP growth has declined by around 1 percentage point since the early 2000s. Information criteria and marginal likelihood comparisons support our model specification. The model also provides a unified framework connecting the literature on turning-point detection to the more recent literature on Growth-at-Risk in macroeconomic forecasting. While tightening financial conditions are shown to increase the probability of falling into recession, the model can generate left-skewed density forecasts without including any financial variable in the information set. The paper finally discusses how to deal with the COVID-19 period when estimating the model.
abstract_zh: 正如大衰退、新冠疫情以及自2000年代中期以来全球GDP增长的放缓所展示的，经济学家需要解释突然而深度的衰退、宏观经济波动性的变化以及GDP增长的长期波动。本文提出了一种均值-方差马尔可夫转换动态因子模型（MV-MS-DFM），该模型通过允许宏观经济变量的均值和波动性发生突变，以及趋势GDP增长随时间平滑变化，来适应这些典型事实。我们证明，允许不同的波动性制度存在，能提高对美国商业周期转折点的识别能力；大衰退和新冠疫情仅导致了波动性的暂时上升；而自2000年代初以来，美国趋势GDP增长已下降了约1个百分点。信息准则和边际似然比较支持我们的模型设定。该模型还提供了一个统一框架，将转折点检测的文献与宏观经济预测中较新的增长风险文献联系起来。虽然金融状况收紧被证明会增加陷入衰退的概率，但该模型无需在信息集中包含任何金融变量，就能生成左偏的密度预测。最后，本文讨论了在估计模型时如何处理新冠疫情时期。

title: Do Higher-Cost Settings Deliver Better Outcomes? Post-Acute Care Efficiency in Medicare Skilled Nursing Facilities and Home Health Agencies
title_zh: 更高成本的机构是否带来更好的结果？医疗保险专业护理机构与家庭健康机构的急性后期护理效率
title_primary: 更高成本的机构是否带来更好的结果？医疗保险专业护理机构与家庭健康机构的急性后期护理效率
title_secondary: Do Higher-Cost Settings Deliver Better Outcomes? Post-Acute Care Efficiency in Medicare Skilled Nursing Facilities and Home Health Agencies
authors: Fangli Geng, Jiaowei Gong, Pedro L. Gozalo, David C. Grabowski
official: 官方在线 2026-08-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Determining the value of different post-acute care settings for clinically similar patients is important for providers and payers. This study examines the causal effect of post-acute care (PAC) setting on Medicare spending and short-term patient outcomes among beneficiaries discharged from hospitals following treatment for stroke or congestive heart failure (CHF). Using 2013–2017 Medicare claims data, we implement an instrumental variable strategy that exploits daily variation in skilled nursing facility (SNF) bed occupancy at the hospital service area level to estimate the local average treatment effect of SNF versus home health agency (HHA) care. Our findings reveal no significant differences, on average, in 30-day mortality or rehospitalization rates between SNF and HHA care among stroke and CHF patients. However, the 95% confidence intervals do not exclude clinically meaningful reductions in 30-day mortality. Meanwhile, SNF care is associated with approximately $4,700 more in Medicare spending per PAC episode. The spending gap is larger in markets with more constrained SNF capacity, particularly in states with Certificate of Need regulations, rural areas, and low-income neighborhoods. However, we do not detect statistically significant differences in short-term health outcomes across these markets on average, suggesting that supply constraints may amplify the spending implications of SNF use while the relationship between PAC setting and short-term clinical outcomes remains uncertain. These findings highlight the importance of aligning PAC discharge decisions with both clinical needs and local capacity considerations, particularly under value-based payment models.
abstract_zh: 确定临床相似患者在不同急性后期护理环境中的价值，对医疗服务提供者和支付方而言至关重要。本研究考察了急性后期护理（PAC）环境对中风或充血性心力衰竭（CHF）治疗后出院受益人的医疗保险支出及短期患者结局的因果效应。利用2013-2017年医疗保险索赔数据，我们实施了一种工具变量策略，利用医院服务区域层面熟练护理机构（SNF）床位占用率的日常变化，来估计SNF相对于家庭健康机构（HHA）护理的局部平均处理效应。研究结果显示，在中风和CHF患者中，SNF与HHA护理在30天死亡率或再入院率方面平均无显著差异。然而，95%置信区间并未排除30天死亡率在临床上显著降低的可能性。与此同时，SNF护理与每个PAC疗程约4，700美元的额外医疗保险支出相关。在SNF容量受限更严重的市场中，这一支出差距更大，尤其是在实施需求证明法规的州、农村地区及低收入社区。然而，我们未在这些市场中检测到短期健康结局的统计学显著差异，这表明供给约束可能放大SNF使用的支出影响，而PAC环境与短期临床结局之间的关系仍不确定。这些发现强调了在基于价值的支付模式下，将PAC出院决策与临床需求及当地容量考量相结合的重要性。

title: The anatomy of censorship and propaganda: What Russia’s Wikipedia clone reveals about authoritarian information control
title_zh: 审查与宣传的解剖：俄罗斯维基百科克隆版揭示的威权信息控制
title_primary: 审查与宣传的解剖：俄罗斯维基百科克隆版揭示的威权信息控制
title_secondary: The anatomy of censorship and propaganda: What Russia’s Wikipedia clone reveals about authoritarian information control
authors: Ekaterina Zhuravskaya, Ulrich Matter, Ruben Durante, Vladimir Avetian
official: 官方在线 2026-08-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Autocratic regimes shape what citizens know through censorship and propaganda, but their priorities are rarely observable at scale. This column exploits the 2023 cloning of Russian-language Wikipedia and its subsequent rewriting into Ruwiki, a regime-aligned alternative. Comparing the two 1.9 million-article corpora reveals a coherent editorial intervention legitimising Russia’s aggression, suppressing opposition and criticism of state institutions, and promoting traditional values. Rewriting is far more common than outright deletion, suggesting that modern information control works primarily by changing the meaning of familiar topics rather than making them disappear.
abstract_zh: 专制政权通过审查和宣传塑造公民的认知，但其优先事项在宏观层面往往难以观察。本文利用2023年俄语维基百科的克隆及其随后被改写为亲政权的替代平台Ruwiki这一事件，比较了两个各含190万篇文章的语料库，揭示出一场连贯的编辑干预，旨在为俄罗斯的侵略行为赋予合法性，压制反对声音及对国家机构的批评，并推广传统价值观。改写远比直接删除更为普遍，这表明现代信息控制主要通过改变熟悉话题的含义来运作，而非使其消失。

title: A New Keynesian model of the term structures of equity and bond returns
title_zh: 股票与债券收益率期限结构的新凯恩斯模型
title_primary: 股票与债券收益率期限结构的新凯恩斯模型
title_secondary: A New Keynesian model of the term structures of equity and bond returns
authors: Pierlauro Lopez, Francisco Vazquez-Grande, David Lopez-Salido
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A simple production economy with nominal price rigidities explains several key asset pricing facts, including the average slopes and cyclicality of equity and interest rate term structures. Nominal rigidities amplify the procyclicality of dividends after negative productivity shocks and generate countercyclical inflation, as sluggish price adjustment leads to a gradual dividend recovery. Consequently, short-duration equities (bonds) have more (less) procyclical payoffs than their long-duration counterparts. Slow-moving consumption habits produce large, countercyclical risk prices, yielding realistic asset valuations. Extending Campbell–Cochrane preferences with both market- and home-consumption habits allows them to operate in production economies while preserving realistic macroeconomic dynamics.
abstract_zh: 一个具有名义价格刚性的简单生产经济模型，能够解释若干关键资产定价事实，包括股票和利率期限结构的平均斜率及其周期性。名义刚性放大了负向生产率冲击后股息的前瞻性周期性，并产生反周期的通货膨胀，因为价格调整迟缓导致股息逐步恢复。因此，短久期股票（债券）的支付比长久期对应物更具（更不）前瞻性周期性。缓慢变动的消费习惯产生大规模、反周期的风险价格，从而得出符合现实的资产估值。将Campbell–Cochrane偏好扩展至同时包含市场消费习惯和家庭消费习惯，使其能在生产经济中运作，同时保持现实宏观经济动态。

title: Screening Adaptive Cartels
title_zh: 筛选适应性卡特尔
title_primary: 筛选适应性卡特尔
title_secondary: Screening Adaptive Cartels
authors: Ortner, Juan, Chassang, Sylvain, Kawai, Kei
official: 卷期日期 2026-09-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We propose an equilibrium theory of data-driven antitrust oversight in which regu- lators launch investigations on the basis of suspicious bidding patterns and cartels can adapt to the statistical screens used by regulators. Our main result establishes that screening for collusion using tests with a low false-positive rate (safe tests) is a robust improvement over laissez-faire. Safe tests do not create new collusive equilibria, and do not hurt competitive industries. In addition, safe tests can have strict bite, including unraveling all collusive equilibria in some settings.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种数据驱动反垄断监管的均衡理论，其中监管机构基于可疑投标模式发起调查，而卡特尔组织能够适应监管机构使用的统计筛查手段。我们的主要结论表明，采用低误报率（安全检验）的合谋筛查方法，相较于自由放任政策具有稳健的改进效果。安全检验既不会催生新的合谋均衡，也不会损害竞争性行业。此外，安全检验具有严格约束力，在某些情境下甚至能瓦解所有合谋均衡。

title: Conditioning Out the Poor? Consumption Inequality and the Design of Cash Transfer Programs
title_zh: 排除穷人？消费不平等与现金转移计划的设计
title_primary: 排除穷人？消费不平等与现金转移计划的设计
title_secondary: Conditioning Out the Poor? Consumption Inequality and the Design of Cash Transfer Programs
authors: Anagol, Santosh, Fujiwara, Thomas, Navarrete, Martin
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review: Insights · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Conditionality can exclude poor households from receiving transfers. Reanalyzing five randomized evaluations of conditional cash transfers (CCTs), we find that 9–37 percent of eligible recipients fail to meet conditions, and they typically have lower baseline consumption. We assess the welfare implications of budget-neutral shifts from CCTs to unconditional cash transfers. Conditionality exacerbating inequality among eligible recipients can be quantitatively important for welfare impacts. We quantify how large conditionality-induced human capital gains must be for the welfare benefits of CCTs to outweigh the inequality costs generated by conditionality.
abstract_zh: 条件性可能导致贫困家庭无法获得转移支付。通过对五项有条件现金转移支付（CCTs）的随机评估进行再分析，我们发现9%至37%的合格受助者未能满足条件，且这些家庭通常基线消费水平较低。我们评估了从有条件现金转移支付转向无条件现金转移支付的预算中性调整对福利的影响。条件性加剧合格受助者之间的不平等，可能对福利效应产生显著的量化影响。我们量化了条件性带来的人力资本增益需达到何种程度，才能使有条件现金转移支付的福利收益超过条件性所产生的不平等成本。

title: Platform-Mediated Competition
title_zh: 平台中介的竞争
title_primary: 平台中介的竞争
title_secondary: Platform-Mediated Competition
authors: Valenzuela-Stookey, Quitzé
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In many markets the interaction between individuals and competing firms is mediated by a strategic platform. A defining feature of modern platforms is their extensive ability to control interactions. To understand such markets, I incorporate within-side externalities into a general mechanism-design model of many-to-many matching in two-sided markets. I characterize platform-optimal mechanisms and establish comparative statics. I analyze the implications and welfare effects of changes in market structure, including vertical integration by the platform and changes in the platform's information about firms. I then extend the canonical Dixit-Stiglitz model of monopolistic competition by giving the platform control over consideration sets.
abstract_zh: 在许多市场中，个体与竞争企业之间的互动由战略性平台中介。现代平台的一个显著特征是其对互动的广泛控制能力。为理解此类市场，我将同侧外部性纳入双边市场中多对多匹配的一般机制设计模型。我刻画了平台最优机制并建立了比较静态分析，进而探讨市场结构变化（包括平台纵向整合及平台对企业信息的变化）的影响与福利效应。最后，我通过赋予平台对考虑集合的控制权，扩展了经典的迪克西特-斯蒂格利茨垄断竞争模型。

title: Food Price Trends and Projections in Brazil (2018–2026): Implications for Access to Adequate and Healthy Food
title_zh: 巴西食品价格趋势与预测（2018-2026年）：对获取充足健康食品的影响
title_primary: 巴西食品价格趋势与预测（2018-2026年）：对获取充足健康食品的影响
title_secondary: Food Price Trends and Projections in Brazil (2018–2026): Implications for Access to Adequate and Healthy Food
authors: Thaís Cristina Marquezine Caldeira, Bruna Barbosa Furtado, Ana Maria Thomaz Maya Martins, Laís Amaral Mais, Ramon Torres 等
official: 官方在线 2026-07-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study analyzed post‐COVID‐19 trends in food prices in Brazil and projected changes through 2026. Time series from the 2017/2018 Household Budget Survey, the National System of Consumer Price Indexes, and the Continuous National Household Sample Survey were analyzed using Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA) models. Between 2018 and 2024, prices of ultra‐processed food products (UPFP) decreased by 16%, while unprocessed or minimally processed foods and culinary ingredients increased, narrowing the price gap. The nominal prices of food groups rose more than nominal household income between 2018 and 2024, particularly for unprocessed or minimally processed foods and culinary ingredients. Projections indicate that UPFP will remain the cheapest group by 2026, reinforcing barriers to healthy diets and supporting tax policies.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究分析了巴西在新冠疫情后的食品价格趋势，并预测了截至2026年的变化。研究利用2017/2018年家庭预算调查、国家消费者价格指数体系以及连续全国住户抽样调查的时间序列数据，采用季节性自回归积分滑动平均模型（SARIMA）进行分析。2018年至2024年间，超加工食品（UPFP）价格下降了16%，而未加工或 minimally 加工食品及烹饪原料的价格则有所上涨，从而缩小了价格差距。2018年至2024年间，各类食品的名义价格涨幅超过了名义家庭收入，尤其是未加工或 minimally 加工食品及烹饪原料。预测显示，到2026年，超加工食品仍将是最便宜的类别，这加剧了健康饮食的障碍，并为税收政策提供了支持依据。

title: Retrieval Failures and Consumption Smoothing: A Field Experiment on Seasonal Poverty
title_zh: 检索失败与消费平滑：关于季节性贫困的实地实验
title_primary: 检索失败与消费平滑：关于季节性贫困的实地实验
title_secondary: Retrieval Failures and Consumption Smoothing: A Field Experiment on Seasonal Poverty
authors: Ned Augenblick, B. Kelsey Jack, Supreet Kaur, Felix Masiye, Nicholas Swanson
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Individuals may fail to recall and use information they already know when making decisions. We empirically investigate whether such “retrieval failures” distort consumption smoothing behavior among Zambian farmers, who derive their income from one annual harvest and then spend it down over the course of the year. We document that individuals underestimate upcoming spending by 50%, creating scope for under-saving. In order to improve recall, we randomize an intervention that prompts individuals to think through their future expenses associatively in categories—without providing any external information or guidance. Treated individuals increase “remembered” expenses by 36-60%; as predicted by the memory literature, effects are concentrated among small, irregular, and stochastic items. Immediate spending drops and, six weeks after the intervention, treated households hold 15% higher savings. They subsequently enter the hungry season—the final months of the year when consumption typically declines sharply—with one additional month of savings, leading to a flatter spending profile over the year. Households use the increased savings to self-finance additional farm investment, resulting in a 9% increase in the next year’s crop revenue. We replicate the intervention’s impact on beliefs among low-income Americans, suggesting that retrieval failures generalize across settings and populations.
abstract_zh: 个体在决策时可能无法回忆并使用已知信息。我们通过实证研究考察这种"检索失败"是否会扭曲赞比亚农民的消费平滑行为——这些农民的收入来源于每年一次收获，随后在全年逐步消耗。研究发现，个体对未来支出的低估幅度达50%，这为储蓄不足创造了空间。为改善信息检索能力，我们随机实施了一项干预措施：引导受试者按类别联想未来支出（不提供任何外部信息或指导）。干预后，受试者"回忆"的支出金额增加36%-60%；正如记忆文献所预测，该效应集中于小额、非经常性及随机性支出项目。即时消费支出下降，干预六周后，受试家庭储蓄额提高15%。随后他们进入青黄不接时期（通常消费急剧下降的年末月份）时，额外拥有一个月的储蓄，这使得全年消费曲线更趋平滑。家庭将增加的储蓄用于农业投资自融资，次年作物收入因此提升9%。我们复现了该干预对低收入美国人信念的影响，表明检索失败现象在不同情境和人群中具有普遍性。

title: What Lies Behind the Returns to Schooling: The Role of Labor Market Sorting and Worker Heterogeneity
title_zh: 教育回报背后的真相：劳动力市场分类与工人异质性的作用
title_primary: 教育回报背后的真相：劳动力市场分类与工人异质性的作用
title_secondary: What Lies Behind the Returns to Schooling: The Role of Labor Market Sorting and Worker Heterogeneity
authors: Pedro Portugal, Hugo Reis, Paulo Guimarães, Ana Rute Cardoso
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Do more educated workers earn higher wages partly because they have access to high-paying firms and occupations? We rely on linked employer-employee data to combine the estimation of AKM (Abowd-Kramarz-Margolis) models with the decomposition of the returns to schooling. We exploit exogenous variation in education driven by changes in compulsory education. We show that education provides access to better-paying workplaces and occupations: 30% of the overall return to education operates through the workplace channel and 12% through the occupation channel. The remainder is associated exclusively with the individual. Match quality plays a modest role in the returns to education.
abstract_zh: 受教育程度更高的工人获得更高工资，是否部分源于他们能进入高薪企业和职业？我们利用关联雇主-雇员数据，将AKM（Abowd-Kramarz-Margolis）模型的估计与教育回报的分解相结合，并利用义务教育改革带来的教育外生变化进行分析。研究表明，教育为个体提供了进入薪酬更优的工作场所和职业的途径：教育总回报中，30%通过工作场所渠道实现，12%通过职业渠道实现，其余部分则完全与个体特征相关。匹配质量在教育回报中仅发挥有限作用。

title: Tax Incentives and Venture Capital Risk-Taking: Evidence from the QSBS Program
title_zh: 税收激励与风险资本风险承担：来自QSBS项目的证据
title_primary: 税收激励与风险资本风险承担：来自QSBS项目的证据
title_secondary: Tax Incentives and Venture Capital Risk-Taking: Evidence from the QSBS Program
authors: Murillo Campello, Guilherme Junqueira
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Do tax subsidies prompt investors to take on risk? We address this question by looking at investors' responses to changes to the Qualified Small Business Stock (QSBS) program, which reduces capital gains taxes on startup investing. We do so under a framework in which some startup investors — venture capitalists (VCs) — combine outside funding with incentive-based compensation, while others invest their own funds. Using bunching, triple-differences, and matching designs that exploit industry eligibility, investment vintage, and holding-period requirements, we analyze data from 158 thousand investor–firm pairings over two decades. We identify strategic investment timing, with subsidies prompting bunching at tax-eligible holding-period thresholds. Most notably, when and where tax subsidies apply, VCs shift their project selection toward riskier ventures: they invest more in pre-commercial stage startups, become more likely to provide startups with their initial capital, and invest more in startups with pre-existing debt, while becoming less likely to co-syndicate their investments. Tax-subsidized VC-backed ventures show higher failure rates, but on the flip side, attain higher valuations at exit and are more likely to reach "unicorn status." None of these patterns are observed for comparable non-VC investors in startups exposed to the same tax subsidies. Our tests further show that tax incentives lead to reallocation toward more innovative industries, yielding more impactful patents. Our study is the first to show that tax policy can shift entrepreneurial financing toward riskier, more innovative, and valuable startups.
abstract_zh: 税收补贴是否会促使投资者承担风险？我们通过考察投资者对合格小型企业股票（QSBS）计划变化的反应来探讨这一问题，该计划降低了初创企业投资的资本利得税。我们在一个框架下进行分析，其中部分初创企业投资者——风险投资家（VC）——将外部资金与基于激励的薪酬相结合，而其他投资者则使用自有资金。利用行业资格、投资年份和持有期要求，我们采用聚束分析、三重差分和匹配设计，对二十年间15.8万个投资者-企业配对数据进行分析。我们识别出策略性投资时机，即补贴促使投资者在符合税收优惠的持有期阈值处出现聚束现象。最值得注意的是，在税收补贴适用时，风险投资家将项目选择转向风险更高的企业：他们更多投资于商业化前阶段的初创企业，更可能为初创企业提供初始资本，并更多投资于已有债务的初创企业，同时减少联合投资。获得税收补贴的风险投资支持企业失败率更高，但另一方面，它们在退出时获得更高估值，且更可能达到"独角兽地位"。在面临相同税收补贴的可比非风险投资投资者中，未观察到这些模式。我们的进一步检验表明，税收激励导致资源向更具创新性的行业重新配置，产生更具影响力的专利。本研究首次证明，税收政策可将创业融资转向风险更高、更具创新性和价值的初创企业。

title: The Competitive Effects of Mergers with Cournot Competition
title_zh: 古诺竞争下并购的竞争效应
title_primary: 古诺竞争下并购的竞争效应
title_secondary: The Competitive Effects of Mergers with Cournot Competition
authors: Markus Reisinger, Hans Zenger
official: 官方在线 2026-06-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article provides a full characterization of the competitive effects of horizontal mergers in the Cournot model with heterogeneous firms and constant marginal costs. We show that price effects depend only on the smaller merging firm's market share and the number of firms but are independent of the distribution of market shares among other firms. Standard concentration measures, instead, are often misleading. We also provide simple—yet general—closed‐form solutions for merger effects based on pre‐merger parameters. Moreover, we extend the model to study the combination of output and input market power and relate our results to the Merger Guidelines.
abstract_zh: 本文全面刻画了异质性企业且边际成本恒定条件下古诺模型中横向合并的竞争效应。研究表明，价格效应仅取决于规模较小合并企业的市场份额及企业数量，而与其他企业的市场份额分布无关。相比之下，标准集中度指标往往具有误导性。我们基于合并前参数，为合并效应提供了简洁而通用的闭式解。此外，我们将模型拓展至产出市场与投入市场势力的联合分析，并将研究结论与《合并指南》相关联。

title: The COVID-19 Pandemic and International Supply Chains
title_zh: 新冠疫情与国际供应链
title_primary: 新冠疫情与国际供应链
title_secondary: The COVID-19 Pandemic and International Supply Chains
authors: Kleifgen, Eva, Roth, Duncan, Stepanok, Ignat
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has caused major disruptions in international trade and has raised concerns about adverse effects on international supply chains. Using a unique establishment survey matched with administrative data from Germany, we provide novel evidence on how establishments have adjusted their supply chains in response to pandemic-induced disruptions. We find that establishments that experienced difficulties in obtaining intermediate inputs as a result of the pandemic are significantly more likely to change their network of suppliers than establishments without such problems, especially if disruptions affected imports from abroad. Establishments experiencing supply chain difficulties are more likely to replace a distant with a closer supplier. However, these adjustments in response to the pandemic appear to be temporary.
abstract_zh: COVID-19疫情对国际贸易造成了重大冲击，并引发了对国际供应链负面影响的担忧。通过将德国独特的机构调查数据与行政数据相匹配，我们提供了关于机构如何应对疫情引发的供应链中断而进行调整的新证据。研究发现，因疫情而面临中间投入品获取困难的机构，其调整供应商网络的可能性显著高于未遭遇此类问题的机构，尤其是当供应链中断影响到海外进口时。遭遇供应链困难的机构更倾向于用距离更近的供应商替代距离较远的供应商。然而，这些针对疫情的调整似乎是暂时性的。

title: Time-of-day effects on disclosure of intimate partner violence
title_zh: 披露亲密伴侣暴力行为的时间效应
title_primary: 披露亲密伴侣暴力行为的时间效应
title_secondary: Time-of-day effects on disclosure of intimate partner violence
authors: Katherine Theiss
official: 官方在线 2026-06-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Efforts to measure and advance research on intimate partner violence (IPV) often rely on the analysis of data collected from confidential household surveys. Yet, even in confidential settings, women may underreport IPV. I present evidence that, in Sub-Saharan Africa, women with husbands who consume alcohol are 6.4 percentage points less likely to self-report severe physical and/or sexual IPV during evening surveys than during morning surveys. This finding occurs because the expected marginal costs of IPV reporting increase over the day with husbands’ alcohol consumption. My back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that, even if only 10% of interviews conducted by nationally representative IPV survey efforts occur during the evening, time-of-day effects exclude over 314,496 women from estimates of the most severe forms of IPV across Sub-Saharan Africa.
abstract_zh: 衡量和推进亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）研究的工作，往往依赖于对保密性家庭调查所收集数据的分析。然而，即便在保密环境中，女性也可能低报IPV。我提供的证据表明，在撒哈拉以南非洲，丈夫饮酒的女性在晚间调查中自我报告严重身体和/或性IPV的可能性比晨间调查低6.4个百分点。这一发现之所以出现，是因为随着一天中丈夫饮酒量的增加，IPV报告的预期边际成本也随之上升。我的粗略估算显示，即使全国代表性IPV调查工作中仅有10%的访谈在晚间进行，时间效应也会使撒哈拉以南非洲超过314,496名女性被排除在最严重形式IPV的估计之外。

title: Converging Paths : Intergenerational Educational Mobility and the Decline of Gender and Geographic Gaps in Bangladesh
title_zh: 汇聚之路：孟加拉国代际教育流动性与性别及地理差距的缩小
title_primary: 汇聚之路：孟加拉国代际教育流动性与性别及地理差距的缩小
title_secondary: Converging Paths : Intergenerational Educational Mobility and the Decline of Gender and Geographic Gaps in Bangladesh
authors: Olivieri, Sergio, Razzu, Giovanni, Wambile, Ayago Esmubancha
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study examines intergenerational educational mobility in Bangladesh across cohorts born between the 1950s and 1990s, using data from the 2022 Bangladesh Household Income and Expenditure Survey. Intergenerational regression coefficients and intergenerational correlations are estimated, yielding three main findings. First, while the intergenerational regression coefficient declines for the 1990s cohort, suggesting reduced persistence of the effect of parental education on children's outcomes, the intergenerational correlation, which accounts for inequality in educational attainment across both generations, follows an inverted U-shaped pattern, resulting in no net mobility change. This finding reverses earlier evidence of increasing persistence through the 1970s and indicates that educational expansion since the 1980s has progressively benefited children of less-educated parents. Second, unlike patterns observed elsewhere in the region, where urban residence confers mobility advantages, Bangladesh exhibits no urban premium. Overall mobility remains higher in rural areas, although substantial convergence occurs in the 1990s cohort. At the regional level, an East-West convergence is observed, driven by mobility improvements in traditionally less-mobile Eastern regions. Third, women historically exhibited higher mobility than men through the 1980s, with gender convergence emerging only in the 1990s cohort, largely due to accelerated male mobility gains among urban males. Ba ngladesh's educational mobility trajectory is thus characterized by convergence across gender, urban-rural, and region dimensions, a pattern distinct from both its historical experience and broader South Asian trends, although educational gains remain disconnected from labor market outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用2022年孟加拉国家庭收入与支出调查数据，考察了20世纪50年代至90年代出生队列的代际教育流动性。通过估计代际回归系数与代际相关系数，得出三项主要发现。第一，尽管1990年代出生队列的代际回归系数有所下降，表明父母教育对子女教育影响的持续性减弱，但考虑两代教育成就不平等的代际相关系数却呈现倒U型模式，导致净流动性未发生改变。这一发现推翻了此前关于20世纪70年代教育持续性增强的结论，并表明自20世纪80年代以来的教育扩张逐步惠及低教育背景家庭的子女。第二，与南亚其他地区城市居民享有流动性优势的模式不同，孟加拉国并未呈现城市溢价。农村地区的整体流动性仍更高，尽管1990年代出生队列中城乡差距显著趋同。在区域层面，传统流动性较低的东部地区流动性改善，推动了东西部趋同。第三，历史上至20世纪80年代，女性流动性始终高于男性，但性别趋同仅在1990年代出生队列中出现，这主要源于城市男性流动性加速提升。因此，孟加拉国的教育流动性轨迹呈现性别、城乡与区域维度的全面趋同特征——这一模式既不同于其历史经验，也区别于更广泛的南亚趋势，尽管教育收益仍与劳动力市场表现脱节。

title: Socially Optimal Crime and Punishment
title_zh: 社会最优的犯罪与惩罚
title_primary: 社会最优的犯罪与惩罚
title_secondary: Socially Optimal Crime and Punishment
authors: Eduardo Ferraz, Rodrigo R Soares
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper develops a dynamic equilibrium model of crime with heterogeneous agents and human capital accumulation. Agents decide whether to commit crimes by comparing potential gains with the expected punishment. Public security policies are defined as pairs of a size of the police force and an average sentence length. We propose a micro-founded public security technology linking expenditures on police to the probability of apprehension of a criminal. We illustrate the relevance of this theoretical framework by using an estimated version of the model using US data to (i) characterize the socially optimal public security policy; (ii) explore potential complementarities across public security and educational policies; and (iii) show that comparative statics exercises often lead, under reasonable parameter values, to recommendations that differ from those obtained in a global optimality analysis. These results highlight the relevance of equilibrium considerations in the economic analysis of crime. The paper gives a methodological first step towards building a manageable model of crime that can bring together different pieces of evidence—and equilibrium considerations—when evaluating the trade-offs across policy alternatives.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个包含异质性主体与人力资本积累的动态均衡犯罪模型。行为人通过比较潜在收益与预期惩罚来决定是否实施犯罪。公共安全政策被定义为警力规模与平均刑期长度的组合。我们提出了一种基于微观基础的公共安全技术，将警务支出与罪犯被捕概率相关联。通过使用美国数据对模型进行参数估计，我们阐明了该理论框架的适用性，具体用于：（i）刻画社会最优公共安全政策；（ii）探索公共安全政策与教育政策之间的潜在互补性；（iii）证明在合理参数取值下，比较静态分析得出的政策建议往往与全局最优性分析结果存在差异。这些结论凸显了均衡考量在犯罪经济学分析中的重要性。本文为构建一个可操作的犯罪模型提供了方法论基础，该模型能够在评估不同政策方案的权衡时，整合多元实证证据与均衡分析视角。

title: Estimating Causal Effects With Observational Data: Guidelines for Agricultural and Applied Economists
title_zh: 利用观测数据估计因果效应：农业与应用经济学家的指南
title_primary: 利用观测数据估计因果效应：农业与应用经济学家的指南
title_secondary: Estimating Causal Effects With Observational Data: Guidelines for Agricultural and Applied Economists
authors: Arne Henningsen, Guy Low, David Wuepper, Tobias Dalhaus, Hugo Storm 等
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Most research questions in agricultural and applied economics are causal in nature: they study how changes in one or more variables (such as policies, prices or weather) affect one or more other variables (e.g., income, crop yields or pollution). Only a minority of these research questions can be studied with experimental methods, so most empirical studies in agricultural and applied economics rely on observational data. However, estimating causal effects with observational data requires an appropriate research design and a transparent discussion of all identifying assumptions, together with a critical discussion of how plausible they are. This paper provides an overview of approaches that are frequently used in agricultural and applied economics to estimate causal effects with observational data. It then provides advice and guidelines for agricultural and applied economists seeking to estimate causal effects with observational data, including how to assess and discuss the identification strategies adopted in their analysis.
abstract_zh: 摘要 农业与应用经济学中的大多数研究问题本质上是因果性的：它们探讨一个或多个变量（如政策、价格或天气）的变化如何影响一个或多个其他变量（如收入、作物产量或污染）。这些研究问题中只有少数可以通过实验方法进行研究，因此农业与应用经济学中的大多数实证研究依赖于观测数据。然而，利用观测数据估计因果效应需要适当的研究设计和对所有识别假设的透明讨论，并对其合理性进行批判性评估。本文概述了农业与应用经济学中常用于利用观测数据估计因果效应的方法，随后为寻求利用观测数据估计因果效应的农业与应用经济学家提供建议和指导，包括如何评估和讨论其分析中所采用的识别策略。

title: From local to global: How foreign acquisitions reshape job mobility
title_zh: 从本土到全球：外资并购如何重塑职业流动性
title_primary: 从本土到全球：外资并购如何重塑职业流动性
title_secondary: From local to global: How foreign acquisitions reshape job mobility
authors: Carl Davidson, Fredrik Heyman, Steven Matusz, Fredrik Sjöholm, Susan Chun Zhu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper explores the impact of international experience on worker mobility, with a focus on Swedish companies acquired by foreign multinationals. We posit that international experience, by imparting knowledge about foreign operations, enhances an employee’s appeal to multinational enterprises (MNEs). By matching acquired firms with comparable control firms and using a stacked difference-in-differences methodology, we observe a significant impact of foreign acquisitions on job mobility. Our results indicate that foreign acquisitions raise the likelihood of switching to another MNE by 3.6 percentage points, while reducing moves to local firms by approximately 4 percentage points. Furthermore, workers who transition to another MNE post-acquisition have significantly higher wage growth compared to those who stay. Additional analyses reveal that the positive effect on mobility to MNEs is linked to learning opportunities stemming from increased trade linkages within multinational production networks and the implementation of advanced technologies after an acquisition.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了国际经验对劳动力流动性的影响，重点关注被外国跨国公司收购的瑞典企业。我们假设，国际经验通过传授关于外国运营的知识，增强了员工对跨国企业（MNEs）的吸引力。通过将收购企业与可比对照组企业进行匹配，并采用堆叠双重差分法，我们观察到外国收购对职业流动性有显著影响。结果显示，外国收购使员工转向另一家跨国企业的可能性提高了3.6个百分点，而转向本地企业的概率则降低了约4个百分点。此外，收购后转至其他跨国企业的员工，其工资增长显著高于留在原企业的员工。进一步分析表明，对跨国企业流动性的积极影响与学习机会相关，这些机会源于跨国生产网络内贸易联系的增强以及收购后先进技术的实施。

title: Positive and negative selection in bargaining
title_zh: 议价中的正向与负向选择
title_primary: 议价中的正向与负向选择
title_secondary: Positive and negative selection in bargaining
authors: Dongkyu Chang, Duk Gyoo Kim, Wooyoung Lim
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In the standard dynamic screening problem between an uninformed seller and a privately informed buyer, theory suggests that the presence (absence) of the buyer’s outside option leads to a substantial surplus for the seller (buyer). This outcome arises from contrasting unraveling processes that theory predicts: negative selection occurs in the absence of an outside option, while positive selection occurs in the presence of it. We examine the validity of these contrasting unraveling processes and report laboratory data that qualitatively deviate from theoretical predictions. We found that the seller’s profit ranking was reversed between the two environments. In particular, in the presence of an outside option, the buyer frequently rejected current-round offers, leading to pervasive delays; and the seller’s reported beliefs about the buyer’s type were qualitatively more consistent with the negative selection than with the theoretically predicted positive selection.
abstract_zh: 在标准动态筛选问题中，不知情的卖方与拥有私人信息的买方之间，理论表明买方外部选择权的存在（缺失）会导致卖方（买方）获得显著剩余。这一结果源于理论预测的两种相反的去遮蔽过程：在缺乏外部选择权时发生负向选择，而在存在外部选择权时则发生正向选择。我们检验了这些相反去遮蔽过程的有效性，并报告了与理论预测定性偏离的实验室数据。我们发现，卖方利润排名在两种环境之间发生了反转。特别是，在存在外部选择权的情况下，买方频繁拒绝当轮报价，导致普遍延误；且卖方关于买方类型的报告信念在定性上更符合负向选择，而非理论预测的正向选择。

title: Dynamic returns to political tenure
title_zh: 政治任期动态回报
title_primary: 政治任期动态回报
title_secondary: Dynamic returns to political tenure
authors: Bas Machielsen
official: 官方在线 2026-03-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Economists frequently assert that politicians derive financial returns from a political career, but these returns can be obscured by the varying duration of political careers. In this study, I estimate the financial returns associated with successive mandates in the Lower House, capitalizing on the repetitive treatment assignment through close elections in the Netherlands from 1848–1917. Employing a dynamic regression discontinuity framework, I establish that the financial benefits accruing to politicians are due to the first two periods of political tenure, but no substantial returns emerge during the more advanced career stages. These findings emphasize that politicians elected for a first and second term exhibit significantly higher end-of-life wealth than their losing counterparts, equivalent to several years’ salaries. I also explore various potential mechanisms, providing evidence in favor of career-based explanations and against in-office returns. • Dynamic RD estimates financial returns to Dutch political tenure (1848–1917). • Gains concentrate in the first two terms; no wealth premium for longer careers. • Electoral success aids a lucrative pivot to the private legal sector in cities. • There is little evidence for in-office rent-seeking or corruption.

title: Nash and Epsilon-Nash implementation
title_zh: 纳什与ε-纳什实施
title_primary: 纳什与ε-纳什实施
title_secondary: Nash and Epsilon-Nash implementation
authors: Jianxin Yi
official: 官方在线 2026-01-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the implementation problem that arises when the designer is uncertain about the agents’ rationality. We discuss double implementation in Nash and -Nash equilibria.We fully characterize the social choice rules which can be doubly implemented in Nash and ε-Nash equilibria.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了当设计者对参与者理性程度不确定时所产生的实施问题。我们讨论了纳什均衡与ε-纳什均衡下的双重实施。我们完整刻画了能够在纳什均衡与ε-纳什均衡下被双重实施的社会选择规则。

title: Modelling and forecasting tourism revenue with quantile neural networks: an empirical study from China
title_zh: 基于分位数神经网络的旅游收入建模与预测：来自中国的实证研究
title_primary: 基于分位数神经网络的旅游收入建模与预测：来自中国的实证研究
title_secondary: Modelling and forecasting tourism revenue with quantile neural networks: an empirical study from China
authors: Qi Yang Yuzhu Tian Yijing Zhang Yue Wang a School of Mathematics and Statistics, Northwest Normal University, Lanzhou, Chinab Department of Mathematics and Information Technology, The Education University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The rapid expansion of global tourism has underscored the critical need for accurate regional tourism revenue (TR) forecasting to support sustainable economic development. This study takes Shaanxi Province, a major tourism destination in China, as a case to analyse TR trends and predict future changes. We develop a Quantile Neural Network (QNN) model, optimized through grid search and ten-fold cross-validation, which demonstrates superior predictive accuracy compared to benchmark models. To quantify prediction uncertainty, we propose the QNN-Bootstrap algorithm that combines QNN with resampling to construct confidence intervals, enhancing forecast reliability. Furthermore, the model’s generalizability is validated using tourism data from Beijing, confirming its robust performance in diverse regional contexts. To assess potential risks, this study also simulates TR dynamics under external shocks such as economic crises, pandemics, and natural disasters, and discusses the recovery trajectory following the COVID-19 pandemic. The findings provide valuable insights and policy recommendations to support evidence-based decision-making and promote resilient and sustainable tourism development.
abstract_zh: 全球旅游业的快速扩张凸显了准确预测区域旅游收入（TR）以支持可持续经济发展的关键需求。本研究以中国主要旅游目的地陕西省为案例，分析旅游收入趋势并预测未来变化。我们构建了分位数神经网络（QNN）模型，通过网格搜索和十折交叉验证进行优化，相较于基准模型展现出更优的预测精度。为量化预测不确定性，我们提出QNN-Bootstrap算法，将QNN与重抽样方法相结合以构建置信区间，从而增强预测可靠性。此外，利用北京市旅游数据验证了模型的泛化能力，证实其在不同区域情境下的稳健表现。为评估潜在风险，本研究还模拟了经济危机、疫情及自然灾害等外部冲击下的旅游收入动态，并探讨了新冠疫情后的恢复轨迹。研究结果为循证决策提供了有价值的见解与政策建议，有助于推动韧性且可持续的旅游业发展。

title: Less is more: consumers’ preferences for value-based insurance design – evidence from a discrete choice experiment
title_zh: 少即是多：消费者对基于价值的保险设计的偏好——来自离散选择实验的证据
title_primary: 少即是多：消费者对基于价值的保险设计的偏好——来自离散选择实验的证据
title_secondary: Less is more: consumers’ preferences for value-based insurance design – evidence from a discrete choice experiment
authors: Tess L. C. Bardy, Stefan Boes
official: 官方在线 2025-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Value-based insurance design (VBID) can shape health systems to be centred on value by promoting high-value and disincentivizing low-value care use. However, in choice-based insurance systems, concerns arise that individuals might oppose the implementation of VBID. This paper aims to elicit consumers’ preferences for VBID in Switzerland. We fielded a discrete choice experiment and applied mixed logit modelling to estimate individuals’ willingness-to-pay (WTP) for selected VBID elements. The results suggest a status quo bias in health insurance decision-making and resistance to higher cost-sharing or restrictions on low-value care. Posterior WTP distributions reveal substantial preference heterogeneity, which we characterize along the countries’ three language regions and individuals’ background characteristics. Based on the results, tailored communication strategies could be developed to help shape future health policy and support the integration of VBID in basic insurance.
abstract_zh: 基于价值的保险设计（VBID）能够通过促进高价值医疗服务的使用并抑制低价值医疗服务的利用，将医疗体系塑造为以价值为中心。然而，在选择型保险体系中，存在一种担忧，即个体可能会反对VBID的实施。本文旨在探究瑞士消费者对VBID的偏好。我们开展了一项离散选择实验，并运用混合Logit模型来估算个体对特定VBID要素的支付意愿（WTP）。结果表明，在健康保险决策中存在现状偏差，且个体对提高费用分摊或限制低价值医疗服务持有抵触情绪。后验WTP分布揭示了显著的偏好异质性，我们根据该国三个语言区域及个体背景特征对其进行了刻画。基于这些结果，可以制定针对性的沟通策略，以帮助塑造未来的卫生政策，并支持将VBID整合入基本保险之中。

title: Are firms with heavily polluting customers greener? A perspective from environmental legitimacy pressure spillover
title_zh: 高污染客户的企业是否更绿色？环境合法性压力溢出视角
title_primary: 高污染客户的企业是否更绿色？环境合法性压力溢出视角
title_secondary: Are firms with heavily polluting customers greener? A perspective from environmental legitimacy pressure spillover
authors: Yumeng Nie School of Business Jianghan University, Wuhan, P.R.China
official: 官方在线 2025-07-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this study, we examine whether and how the environmental sensitivity of major customers influences their suppliers’ green innovation. Drawing on the spillover effect perspective, we argue that major customers located in heavily polluting industries face heightened stakeholder scrutiny, which can spill over to their suppliers and motivate the suppliers to enhance green innovation. Using as a sample of Chinese listed firms from 2008 to 2021 and adopting the Tobit regression analysis, we find a positive effect of heavily polluting customers on suppliers’ green innovation. Moreover, the geographical proximity and interlocking directors between the customers and suppliers tend to amplify, while suppliers’ ISO 14,001 certification tends to mitigate, the above effect. Mechanism analysis indicates that increased media attention towards suppliers’ environmental practices serves as a channel through which spillover occurs. Our study contributes to the literature by clarifying how major customers influence supplier green innovation and enriching the understanding of spillover effects in supply chains. KEYWORDS: Major customers green innovation customer-supplier relationship spillover effect JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q55 M10 M14
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨主要客户的环境敏感性是否及如何影响其供应商的绿色创新。基于溢出效应视角，我们提出，位于重污染行业的主要客户面临更严格的外部利益相关者审查，这种审查压力会沿供应链传导至供应商，进而激励供应商提升绿色创新水平。以2008至2021年中国上市公司为样本，采用Tobit回归分析，我们发现重污染客户对供应商绿色创新具有正向促进作用。此外，客户与供应商之间的地理邻近性与连锁董事关系会强化该效应，而供应商的ISO 14001认证则会弱化该效应。机制分析表明，媒体对供应商环境实践关注度的提升是溢出效应发生的重要传导渠道。本研究通过阐明主要客户影响供应商绿色创新的作用机制，丰富了供应链溢出效应的理论认知。关键词：主要客户；绿色创新；客户-供应商关系；溢出效应 JEL分类：Q55 M10 M14
